description: A strategy that favors many integration tests, fewer unit and E2E tests, on top of static analysis.
Vite-native test runner with a Jest-compatible API (`vi.fn`, `vi.mock`). Browser Mode runs tests in real browsers.
Renders components and queries the DOM the way users do (`getByRole`, `getByLabelText`, `getByText`).
Simulates realistic interactions (typing, clicking, keyboard) by dispatching the full event sequence.
End-to-end frameworks that drive real browsers against the running app.
Mock Service Worker: intercepts HTTP requests at the network level in Node and the browser.
